data_fields.name: party_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: MAX_PARTY_SIZE = GemRB.GetVar("MaxPartySize") (value not read); 0 means no cap

data_fields.name: slot_base
data_fields.donor_constant: slots start at 1; a join takes size+1

data_fields.name: start_position_by_slot
data_fields.donor_constant: startpos table column = slot minus one (table values not read)

best_idea: Keep the party as one ordered roster with 1-based slots: a join takes the next slot, a leave shifts higher slots down, and the server refuses joins over the cap instead of allowing an overflow state.
decision_why: The roster and slot-shift rule are simple and testable, which suits server-owned social state. Reject the donor's over-cap-then-reform flow: Frankendom refuses over-cap joins on the server, so no overflow state exists.
acceptance: A server test with cap 3 and three members returns full for a fourth join and leaves the roster unchanged; after the member in slot 2 leaves, the other two show slots 1 and 2 in the next state sync.
